title: Renewal risk, Q3 — EMEA/APAC
audience: The regional sales leadership team,	who own the renewal number.
purpose: Get the early-warning pipeline funded before the Q4 renewal wave.
argument: Churn is predictable a quarter ahead — and today nobody looks at any of it.
call_to_action: Approve two engineers for one quarter: our #1 priority.
narrative_arc: Frame the problem: renewals are slipping and nobody can say which accounts.
2024. The signal existed, but it arrived after the renewal date.
- Close on the ask: fund the *early-warning* pipeline this quarter.

resolved_data.synthesis: Three quarters of churn history | aggregated by region & segment.

components.name: Big stat
components.use: One headline number with a short label beneath it.

components.name: Note
components.use: A one-line aside under the exhibit.

components.name: Callout
components.use: The one sentence the reader must act on.
components.example_html: Approve two engineers for one quarter.

slides.purpose: Open on the number nobody can explain.
slides.content_brief:
Title slide: the headline churn rate
and the quarter it lands in.

slides.content_brief: One stat: ARR at risk, with its share of Q4.

slides.hands_off: The reader wants to know what fixing it costs.
slides.look: One dk-stat across the body; its share of Q4 in a dk-note beneath it, *not* a chart.

slides.purpose: Land the ask while the cause is still fresh.
slides.content_brief: Closing slide: the two-engineer ask, scoped to one quarter.
slides.hands_off: The deck ends on a decision the reader can make in the room.
